summary: Korean naval commander during the Joseon dynasty, renowned for his victories against the Japanese navy during the Imjin War. He is celebrated for his innovative use of the turtle ship (geobukseon) and his undefeated record in naval warfare.
Korean independence activist who organized and led the March 1st Movement protests in Cheonan during the Japanese colonial period. She was arrested, tortured, and died in prison at the age of 17.

Korean independence activist who assassinated Itō Hirobumi, the first Resident-General of Korea, at Harbin railway station in 1909. He is regarded as a national hero in Korea for his resistance against Japanese imperialism.

The 19th king of Goguryeo who dramatically expanded the kingdom's territory, making it one of the largest empires in East Asian history. His achievements are recorded on the Gwanggaeto Stele, one of the most significant historical monuments in Korean history.
